title: Route-Target Mismatch — VNI 10012 on dc1-leaf2a
symptom: Hosts in VLAN 12 (VNI 10012) cannot communicate across leaves. dc1-leaf2a has 0 MAC entries for VNI 10012 despite Established EVPN sessions.
root_cause: Route-target for VLAN 12 changed to 10012:88888 on dc1-leaf2a. dc1-leaf1a still exports 10012:10012 which dc1-leaf2a no longer imports.
fix_command:
router bgp 65102
vlan 12
no route-target both 10012:88888
route-target both 10012:10012
